items.title: Creatify Max串接廣告研究、素材與推出審批
items.title_en: Creatify Max connects ad research, creative and launch approvals
items.summary: Creatify推出Max，讓團隊從競品研究、素材製作到活動草擬，在Creatify或Slack內處理。
items.summary_en: Creatify launched Max for competitor research, creative production and campaign drafting inside Creatify or Slack.
highlights: 推出、預算及暫停建議會以批准卡呈現；個別例行工作可另行授權自動執行。
Slack支援排程報表，以及在討論串批准或拒絕建議。
highlights_en: Launch, budget and pause proposals arrive as approval cards; a trusted routine can be separately authorized to act autonomously.
Slack supports scheduled reports and approval or dismissal of proposals in threads.
items.why: 創意與媒體操作由同一代理銜接，投放團隊可決定哪些建議需逐次審閱，哪些固定檢查適合設成例行工作。
items.why_en: Media teams can decide which proposals need repeated review and which fixed checks fit a scheduled routine.
items.next_step: 選一組預算調整建議，核對批准卡的金額、活動及批准人紀錄，再界定是否授權任何單一例行工作。
items.next_step_en: Reconcile campaign names, amounts and approver records on a budget-change card before authorizing any individual routine.
items.detail: Max可由商品連結、簡報或媒體計劃草擬活動，並沿用命名、預算及定向規則。公司亦列出競品廣告研究與素材生成能力。團隊可先追查一項研究發現如何轉成素材和活動設定，核對批准卡能否完整交代變更，再決定如何分配代理與人員的操作責任。這些是公司公布的工作流程。
items.detail_en: Max drafts campaigns from product links, briefs or media plans using naming, budget and targeting rules. Trace a research finding into creative and campaign settings, then check that the approval card explains the changes before assigning operating responsibilities.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: EcerClaw把出口網站內容、多語客服及CRM串接
items.title_en: EcerClaw links export-site content, multilingual service and CRM
items.summary: Ecer推出EcerClaw，以三個AI模組支援出口企業的網站內容、買家查詢及銷售跟進。
items.summary_en: Ecer launched EcerClaw with three AI modules for export businesses' site content, buyer inquiries and sales follow-up.
highlights: Claw Customer Service提供即時翻譯及業界術語識別，用於多語客戶支援。
Claw CRM連接潛在客戶追蹤、跟進及行銷自動化。
highlights_en: Claw Customer Service provides translation and industry-term recognition for multilingual support.
Claw CRM links lead tracking, follow-up and marketing automation.
items.why: 外貿查詢可由網站內容延伸至多語對話及CRM，出口行銷團隊可決定哪些買家問題應帶入後續銷售紀錄。
items.why_en: Export marketers can decide which buyer questions should travel from website conversations into sales records.
items.next_step: 用一項產品規格查詢，核對網站內容、客服翻譯和CRM跟進欄位是否保留相同型號及需求。
items.next_step_en: Trace one product-specification inquiry through content, translation and CRM fields, checking that model numbers and requirements stay consistent.
items.detail: Claw Editor被公司定位為協助搜尋與AI搜尋內容的編寫工具，其他模組負責接待和跟進。這些功能描述可用於檢查跨工序交接，並不能證明網站排名或訂單已提升。團隊可先挑選一個產品系列，列出買家常問的規格及術語，再評估哪些資料需要在內容、對話和銷售紀錄之間保留。
items.detail_en: Ecer positions Claw Editor for search and AI-search content, alongside service and follow-up modules. These mechanisms support handoff evaluation rather than proving rankings or order growth. Start with one product family and define the specifications and terms that must survive each handoff.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: MoEngage整合個人AI決策，Merlin代理連接行銷資料
items.title_en: MoEngage integrates individual AI decisioning with Merlin workflows
items.summary: MoEngage在NEXT Autumn’26公布Merlin代理工具及已整合的Aampe AI Decisioning，連接個人偏好與活動執行。
items.summary_en: MoEngage announced Merlin capabilities and integrated Aampe AI Decisioning at NEXT Autumn’26.
highlights: Merlin Agent Harness加入Context Hub、創意生成及雙向連接器。
Merlin Agent可跨資料倉庫、CRM及分析工具找出指標變化並提出活動建議。
highlights_en: Merlin Agent Harness adds a Context Hub, creative generation and two-way connectors.
Merlin Agent spans warehouses, CRM and analytics to identify metric changes and propose campaigns.
items.why: 個人偏好決策與活動提案接在同一平台，客戶經營團隊可決定哪些優惠、渠道及發送時機交予模型選擇。
items.why_en: Lifecycle teams can decide which offer, channel and timing choices to delegate to individual-level decisioning.
items.next_step: 用一項重複購買提醒列出可變的優惠、內容、渠道和時機，向供應商確認可設定的審閱點及適用帳戶。
items.next_step_en: For one repeat-purchase reminder, list variable offers, content, channels and timing, then confirm review points and account access.
items.detail: 公告把AI Decisioning描述為已整合到MoEngage，並由行銷人員設定品牌規則及審閱位置。個人化決策是按每位客戶的偏好調整選項，與單純按群組發送有所不同。團隊可先限定一項訊息目標，再檢查代理如何把指標變動連接至提案，逐步決定要採用的決策範圍與人工審閱方式。
items.detail_en: MoEngage describes decisioning as integrated, with marketers setting brand guardrails and review points. Individual preferences differ from a group-only send. Limit the initial message objective and inspect how an observed metric change becomes a proposal before selecting the scope of automated decisions.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: HighLevel為Managed Agents加入對話排程功能
items.title_en: HighLevel adds conversational scheduling to Managed Agents
items.summary: HighLevel加入Routines，讓使用者以自然語言安排重複任務，結果回到建立任務的對話。
items.summary_en: HighLevel added Routines for recurring tasks described in natural language, with results returned to the originating conversation.
highlights: 每人每個代理最多10項啟用例行工作，最短執行間隔為1小時。
涉及新權限的敏感動作會暫停，付款一律需要批准。
highlights_en: The limit is ten active routines per person per agent, with a one-hour minimum interval.
Sensitive actions needing new permissions pause; payments always require approval.
items.why: 潛在客戶與商機報表可由手動要求改為固定排程，CRM團隊可決定哪些每日檢查需要持續送回同一討論串。
items.why_en: CRM teams can choose which lead and deal checks to schedule into an ongoing discussion.
items.next_step: 先建立一項新客戶及停滯商機摘要，核對首次授權、執行時間及回傳內容，再考慮增加其他例行工作。
items.next_step_en: Start with one new-lead and stalled-deal summary, checking initial permission, timing and returned content.
items.detail: Routines使用已發布的代理版本，每次執行沿用Managed Agents的使用計費。團隊可在專用分頁暫停、恢復及管理權限。合作夥伴的11月20日更新介紹了這項功能，官方變更記錄列明操作規則。郵件通知仍屬後續計劃，現階段應以原對話內的更新作為檢視入口。
items.detail_en: Routines use the published agent version and standard usage billing. A dedicated tab manages pauses, resumption and permissions. A partner's November 20 update introduced the feature, while the official changelog specifies its rules. Email notifications remain planned, so review updates in the conversation.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: 贊助案例：G-NiiB整理網站結構，回應AI搜尋
items.title_en: Sponsored case: G-NiiB restructures its site for AI search
items.summary: WPP Media Hong Kong在贊助文章介紹G-NiiB的AI搜尋工作，包含結構化資料、FAQ及商品頁面的整理。
items.summary_en: WPP Media Hong Kong described G-NiiB's structured data, FAQs and product-page changes in a sponsored case article.
highlights: 案例列出標準網址、商品圖片描述及分散頁面整合等調整。
11月20日發布的文章描述較早的2026年4至6月評估，並披露WPP贊助。
highlights_en: The work covers canonical URLs, image descriptions and consolidation of fragmented pages.
Published November 20, the sponsored article describes an earlier April–June 2026 evaluation.
items.why: AI答案能否辨識一致的商品資料，與網站結構及內容來源有關；品牌搜尋團隊可決定哪些重複商品頁需要先整合。
items.why_en: Brand search teams can assess which duplicate product pages to consolidate so AI systems can identify consistent product information.
items.next_step: 挑一組內容分散的商品頁，比對標準網址、FAQ及圖片描述，再以固定問題記錄AI答案使用了哪些來源。
items.next_step_en: Compare canonical URLs, FAQs and image descriptions for one fragmented product group, then log which sources fixed AI questions retrieve.
items.detail: 這是供應商披露的案例機制，並非本刊獨立成效測試。結構化資料是供搜尋系統讀取的欄位，標準網址則用來辨識主要頁面。團隊可把頁面整合與AI引用觀察分開記錄，保留問題、模型及日期，避免把同一期間的其他行銷變化都歸因於網站調整。原文由WPP Media Hong Kong贊助。
items.detail_en: This is a vendor-described mechanism, not our independent outcome test. Structured data supplies machine-readable fields; canonical URLs identify main pages. Log consolidation separately from AI citation observations, retaining question, model and date. The original article is sponsored by WPP Media Hong Kong.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: 更進新聞：Google在美國擴展Connected Apps零售結帳
items.title_en: Update: Google expands Connected Apps grocery checkout in the US
items.summary: Google宣布在美國Search及Gemini推出更多Connected Apps，涵蓋Albertsons、Safeway、Shaw’s及Target。
items.summary_en: Google is rolling out Connected Apps for Albertsons, Safeway, Shaw’s and Target through Search and Gemini in the US.
highlights: 新增零售應用以Universal Commerce Protocol支援建立訂單及結帳。
Angi及Thumbtack的帳戶連結仍列為未來數週推出。
highlights_en: The grocery apps use Universal Commerce Protocol for order building and checkout.
Angi and Thumbtack account linking remains planned for the coming weeks.
items.why: 商品探索至結帳可在助理入口銜接，零售團隊可評估哪些訂單資訊需要在對話內呈現，哪些仍需轉回商戶流程。
items.why_en: Retail teams can assess which order details belong in an assistant conversation and where a merchant handoff is still needed.
items.next_step: 以一組雜貨商品列出選品、購物籃及結帳的交接點，向支援商戶確認每一步可傳遞的資料。
items.next_step_en: Map product selection, basket and checkout handoffs for one grocery set, then confirm supported data with the merchant.
items.detail: 這次公告補充了具名零售商的美國接入，並非所有商戶都可加入。Universal Commerce Protocol是連接商務服務的協定。團隊可把訂單建立與付款確認分開檢視，再核對價格、供應及履約資訊的更新方式。對跨市場品牌而言，美國流程可作研究對象，其他市場的接入仍需另行確認。
items.detail_en: The update names US retailers rather than opening access to every merchant. Universal Commerce Protocol connects commerce services. Review order creation separately from payment confirmation, including updates to price, supply and fulfillment. Confirm other markets separately.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.followup: 10月29日版報道Connected Apps平台預覽；11月20日更新列出美國零售商的接入及結帳安排。
items.followup_en: Our October 29 issue covered the platform preview. The November 20 update names US retailers and their order and checkout access.

items.title: Observe.AI公布跨AI與人工客服的即時監督工具
items.title_en: Observe.AI announces live supervision across AI and human service
items.summary: Observe.AI推出Agent Overwatch，監察支援的AI代理及人工客服對話，並把需關注的互動通知主管。
items.summary_en: Observe.AI introduced Agent Overwatch to monitor supported AI and human conversations and alert supervisors to interactions needing attention.
highlights: 企業可設定風險及升級條件，經支援的Slack或Teams渠道接收告警。
主管可查看逐字稿；旁聽、加入通話等介入方式視渠道及整合而定。
highlights_en: Enterprises configure risk and escalation criteria, with supported Slack or Teams alerts.
Supervisors can access transcripts; listening or joining depends on channel and integration support.
items.why: 多家AI供應商的客服對話可放在同一監督流程評估，客戶體驗團隊可決定哪些失敗互動須即時轉交主管。
items.why_en: Customer-experience teams can define which failed interactions across multiple AI providers need a supervisor during the conversation.
items.next_step: 以一項反覆誤解的售前查詢，核對告警原因、逐字稿及可介入渠道，確認客戶是否需要重新交代問題。
items.next_step_en: Check the alert reason, transcript and intervention channel for a repeated pre-sales misunderstanding.
items.detail: 公告列出的訊號包括未授權要求、重複誤解及自動流程失敗。這些訊號供主管判斷是否接手，並非每一項告警都代表已發生事故。團隊可從現有服務渠道挑選具體場景，確認支援的代理、通知工具及主管動作，再安排誰負責處理不同等級的升級。公告描述的是監督機制，成效仍需按團隊自己的服務記錄評估。
items.detail_en: Signals include unauthorized requests, repeated misunderstandings and failed automation. An alert is a prompt for judgment rather than proof of an incident. Map supported agents, notification tools and supervisor actions for specific service scenarios before assigning escalation responsibilities.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Gemini API預覽按需載入工具規格，減少預先放入的內容
items.title_en: Gemini API previews on-demand tool schemas
items.summary: Google在Interactions API推出Tool Retrieval預覽，讓代理需要某項工具時才載入完整參數規格。
items.summary_en: Google introduced Tool Retrieval in preview in the Interactions API, loading complete parameter schemas when an agent needs a tool.
highlights: 模型仍會看到延後載入工具的名稱及描述。
功能支援Gemini 3.6及後續模型；推論仍按標準token費率計費。
highlights_en: The model still sees names and descriptions of deferred tools.
It supports Gemini 3.6 and later models, with standard token billing.
items.why: 串接大量行銷工具的團隊可調整代理每次請求要接收的規格，決定哪些常用工具預先載入，哪些按需搜尋。
items.why_en: Teams connecting many marketing tools can choose which schemas to load upfront and which to retrieve as needed.
items.next_step: 以同一組分析與CRM工具比較完整載入和延後載入，記錄實際輸入token及工具選擇，再決定採用範圍。
items.next_step_en: Compare full and deferred loading for the same analytics and CRM tools, recording input tokens and tool choices.
items.detail: 參數規格說明工具需要接收哪些資料。開發者可加入tool_search，並把指定工具設為defer_loading。Google亦支援遠端MCP工具及由客戶端執行的搜尋。團隊可先保留高頻工具，再測試其他工具延後載入的情況；實際費用取決於哪些規格被載入，以及後續對話使用的內容。
items.detail_en: A schema defines the data a tool expects. Developers add tool_search and mark tools with defer_loading. Remote MCP and client-side search are supported. Keep frequent tools loaded and test the remainder; actual cost depends on schemas retrieved and their later use in the conversation.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: AI Inspo串接社群趨勢、內容生成與表現回顧
items.title_en: AI Inspo connects social trends, creation and performance review
items.summary: AI Inspo推出社群AI代理，把帳戶分析、趨勢探索、內容製作及發布放進同一工作流程。
items.summary_en: AI Inspo launched a social agent connecting account analysis, trend discovery, content production and publishing.
highlights: 代理按帳戶目標及發展階段提出內容方向。
使用者可選擇參考格式並加入自己的主題，再以發布表現修訂下一份簡報。
highlights_en: Recommendations reflect account goals and development stage.
Users add their topic to a reference format, then use publication results to inform the next brief.
items.why: 社群團隊可把趨勢選題與下一輪內容規劃連結，決定哪些格式值得延續，哪些需要調整主題或結構。
items.why_en: Social teams can decide which formats to repeat and which topics or structures need revision.
items.next_step: 用同一個品牌主題建立兩種參考格式，記錄生成稿與發布後的觀察，再決定下一份內容簡報要改哪一項。
items.next_step_en: Develop two reference formats for one brand topic and retain drafts and post-publication observations before changing the next brief.
items.detail: 公司把社群策略與創意內容列為兩項核心能力，代理會參照帳戶的過往工作及目標調整建議。團隊可以保留每次選題的理由、使用的參考格式與後續觀察，讓下一輪規劃有具體依據。趨勢格式只是創作起點，實際內容是否適合品牌仍需逐篇審閱，不能由參考帖的表現推定新帖成效。
items.detail_en: The company identifies strategy and creative production as its two core capabilities. Retain the topic rationale, reference format and later observations for each iteration. A trending format is a starting point; its prior performance does not establish results for a new post.

items.title: OBSBOT新攝影機把AI追蹤與鏡頭控制整合
items.title_en: OBSBOT adds AI tracking and camera controls in new Tail models
items.summary: OBSBOT介紹Tail 2 ADV及Tail Air 2，把AI主體追蹤與電動鏡頭控制用於不同拍攝環境。
items.summary_en: OBSBOT introduced Tail 2 ADV and Tail Air 2, combining subject tracking and motorized camera control for different production settings.
highlights: Tail Air 2配備1吋感光元件及AI影像處理晶片。
AI Director Grids把追蹤、預設及Launchpad放進同一控制介面。
highlights_en: Tail Air 2 has a one-inch sensor and an AI image-processing chip.
AI Director Grids brings tracking, presets and Launchpad into one interface.
items.why: 直播與活動拍攝可把跟隨主體的操作交予攝影機，製作團隊可決定哪些鏡位仍需人員持續控制。
items.why_en: Live-production teams can decide which shots suit automated following and which still require continuous camera operation.
items.next_step: 以一段講者走動的活動鏡位列出追蹤、預設切換及人工接手需求，再向供應商確認現場控制方式。
items.next_step_en: Map tracking, preset switches and manual takeover for a moving speaker, then confirm the venue control setup with the supplier.
items.detail: 公司在11月19日紐約活動介紹新產品，相關通訊稿於11月20日發布。Tail 2 ADV面向大型場地及現場活動，Tail Air 2則結合感光元件與AI影像處理。製作團隊可先按鏡位距離、光線及主體移動方式整理需求，再比較自動追蹤與人工控制如何配合，安排實際拍攝的分工。
items.detail_en: The New York introduction took place on November 19; the wire release followed on November 20. ADV targets large venues and events, while Air 2 combines sensor and AI processing. Compare distance, lighting and movement requirements before assigning automated and manual roles.

evidence.audit_status: Ten sources read and separately reopened by same assistant. Semantic AI relevance PASS, specific event-workflow-decision mechanisms and substitution tests recorded. US rollout, preview APIs, per-routine authorization, supported integrations, sponsored case disclosure and older evaluation period preserved. No human approval, product testing or independent results claimed.

review_provenance.first_pass: Original company text, official product documentation and dated direct reporting inspected, not headlines alone.
review_provenance.second_pass: Same assistant separately re-retrieved source text to challenge dates, release stages, scope, attribution and unsupported outcomes; individual references retained.

stories.title_zh: Creatify Max串接廣告研究、素材與推出審批

source_documents.evidence_locator: Official launch L117–123 / Official launch L139–150 / Official launch L165–167
source_documents.access_method: Read source text and locators, then separately reopened it.
source_documents.limitations: Official launch Nov18. Changes presented for approval; users may separately authorize one trusted routine to act autonomously. Removed vendor productivity and ROI claims; no product testing.

claims.claim_zh: Max連接競品研究、素材生成及廣告活動草擬。
